title: Recovery of the H20-TABICL-FT fb100k arm after GPU driver crash: evaluate the saved best.ckpt (epoch-8 prefix of the frozen trajectory)

established_cause.evidence: Windows device logs: nvlddmkm Event ID 153 (NVIDIA driver error) at 2026-10-17T15:07:04 (kills the full-dose attempt) and at 2026-10-17T17:07:32 (kills the fb100k attempt, whose console log ends 17:07:10); LiveKernelEvent 141/144/19e at 14:42:45 during the full-dose run. No Windows application fault, no system OOM event, 19GB RAM free at inspection.
established_cause.conclusion: The NVIDIA driver crashed/reset under sustained TabICL fine-tune load and terminated the process at OS level. This CORRECTS the earlier ledger hypothesis of allocator fragmentation: that hypothesis is not established and is withdrawn; the driver crash is the evidenced cause. Unknown remains WHY the driver crashed (hardware/driver instability under this load); no further root cause is claimed.
established_cause.correction_policy: Recorded as a new append-only ledger correction; the original entry is not edited.

recovered_state.verified: epoch=8 curr_step=8 best_metric=0.9579433793073343; optimizer_state and scheduler_state present; 391 tensors / 27552258 params; finite-weight spot check passed
recovered_state.training_progress: 8 of 10 planned epochs completed; process killed by driver crash at the start of epoch 9; no fold-0 prediction, no result JSON exists
recovered_state.best_vs_baseline: epoch-8 best (0.957943) is +1.4e-4 above the pretrained baseline (0.9578), i.e. the library's safety-net guarantee holds for the saved state

action.what: Build the final inference estimator from best.ckpt (the library's documented TabICLClassifier(model_path=...) reload path, identical weights to the fine-tuner's own step-13 final-estimator construction), fit it on the SAME 100000-row fine-tune training set with n_estimators_inference=8, predict the full fold-0 (139927 rows) in 8192-row chunks, compute the frozen screen metrics, apply the frozen decision rule.
action.why_not_full_rerun: A from-scratch rerun needs ~1.5h of sustained GPU load; the driver crashed twice within 3h of such load today (two nvlddmkm 153 events). A third sustained run has high crash probability, would burn ~1.5 GPU-h of the remaining ~5h, and would produce the same prefix trajectory that is already saved.
action.why_not_two_more_epochs: Continuing via model_path with epochs=2 would re-warm the LR to 1e-5 while the frozen schedule intended ~1e-6 for epochs 9-10: that injects FOREIGN optimization steps into the frozen trajectory (a warm-restart burst at 10x the intended LR), a strictly larger deviation than evaluating the saved prefix. The saved epoch-8 state is a literal prefix of the frozen run, selected by the library's own best-metric rule.
action.deviation_disclosure: DEVIATION: training completed 8 of 10 epochs (GPU driver crash, evidenced above). The evaluated weights are the frozen trajectory's own best-metric checkpoint -- no foreign weight update occurred. The val trajectory (+1.4e-4 total, plateaued across the last 5 epochs, early-stopping patience 8 never exhausted) bounds the counterfactual value of the 2 missing epochs as small. If this arm were PROMISING, the completed 10-epoch arm on a stable run would still be owed before any OOF admission, exactly as the full-dose arm would.

decision_rule: identical to H20-TABICL-FT and its fallback: PROMISING = portfolio_delta >= +5e-5 AND corr_vs_portfolio < 0.995 -> full 5-fold OOF owed; DECORRELATION_COLLAPSE = standalone improves but corr_vs_route >= 0.99; NEGATIVE = standalone < +2e-3 over zero-shot 0.956343. Applied to the fold-0 metrics of the recovered arm.
resource_adaptation_if_oom: If the 8-estimator x 100k-context inference OOMs at 16GB, set inner batch_size 8 -> 4 (splits estimator members into 2 forward batches: identical math, pure batching) before any weaker alternative. Declare in the result JSON if used.
anti_leakage: unchanged: all training/validation rows subsets of FIT, eval fold never seen by training or selection, label-free route view, hash-asserted champion reference, no public-LB feedback.
